text: I took my son to the dentist today. The dentist said he needed a tooth extracted. The dentist was very gentle, just like the reviews said. However, the receptionist was absolutely terrible. She looked at customers with condescension. We were there for medical treatment, not beggars. I would like to suggest to the dentist that she change her staff. No matter how skilled the dentist is, I wouldn't recommend anyone to use her services. Besides not providing any information, she was unhelpful, uncommunicative, and unresponsive. She gave us such a nasty look. It was unacceptable. Absolutely unacceptable.
author_name: ชลบุรี เวลเทค

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบีบี (BB dental clinic)
text: Actually, I don't want to give any stars. Overall, the clinic is okay. The clinic is clean. The doctor is okay, with a gentle touch, which makes me feel less afraid. I went to have a tooth extracted. It was very fast and there is no abnormal soreness. However, the staff or the doctor's assistants do not feel okay at all. They seem unprepared to work, not smiling, and they abandon the patients' dreams. Sometimes, we want to keep our dreams, even if they are decayed. I have been to other clinics before and they ask after the extraction whether the customer wants the tooth back or not. But this clinic did not ask or do anything. I forgot to ask for it myself. However, after riding my motorcycle for a bit, I just remembered when I left the clinic and chatted with the shop. They did not respond. They only responded after I called. When I got home, I called and the answer was that it had been thrown away. So I asked them to help look for it. They called back again and said they couldn't find it because it was mixed with other things.
